title: Deterministic Media Graph Node Ids
description: Fix non-deterministic media-graph node id minting in framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs. apply_os_operation's OsOp::SpawnAppInstance arm currently calls create_os_id("node") fresh every time the op is replayed (uses a process-global atomic counter), which breaks determinism: replaying the same edit history on two different stores produces different node ids. Fix: add a node_id: String field to OsOp::SpawnAppInstance, mint it once in OsStore::spawn_app_instance at dispatch time (mirroring how instance_id/document_id are already minted there), and have apply_os_operation's SpawnAppInstance arm use the op's own node_id instead of re-minting. Also fix the op's inverse/undo logic (RemoveAppInstance's inverse reconstructing SpawnAppInstance) to reuse the removed node's id rather than minting a fresh one. Hand-fix every other OsOp::SpawnAppInstance construction site repo-wide (Rust and any JSON/TS fixture constructions). Check for other OsOp variants with the same bug pattern (calling create_os_id("node") during apply/replay instead of at dispatch time). This fixes the only remaining divergence in host::tests::concurrent_delete_and_wire_reconciles_without_a_dangling_edge (peers converge on same content but different node id strings).
